text: Public dataset distributors provide CIFAR-10/100, Office-Home, MedMNIST v2, CIFAR-10.1, PACS, VLCS, and DomainNet. The versioned repository at https://github.com/october25kim/fedcore provides the count-to-decision implementation and the evidence listed in its claim-artifact ledger. Release v0.8.0 contains the complete PACS 30-model denominator, all registered H/S/B decisions, the matched fixed-prior betting comparison, the VLCS and DomainNet protocol and aggregate evidence, and the PACS training-reproduction package. The package includes source commit fa016c199a7c846bbe20b64d54ab34164adf7647, its runtime manifest, an immutable scientific container image, configuration and identity manifests, execution logs, and all 30 checkpoint assets. Licensed source images and pretrained initialization archives are not redistributed. Their acquisition instructions, expected sizes, and hashes are provided instead. The package enables an end-to-end rerun after the user supplies the exact registered PACS archive, but it is not presented as a completed independent clean-machine replication. All theorem-critical definitions and proofs are contained in the manuscript, and no separate supplementary file is required. The release also preserves every adverse external-evaluation cell and the exact file hashes needed to audit the reported denominators.
